data.animaCaption: Parting two slats of the metal venetian blinds to watch the rain-slicked street below, she holds one hand back in a calm hush gesture toward you. Sharp stripes of cyan neon light from outside slice across her matte-black trench coat while the encrypted desk terminal casts a faint green glint onto her cheek.
data.promptProse: Shot at a taut cinematic diagonal past an open encrypted laptop and tactical map in the dark foreground, Shiki Natsume crouches alertly beside a shuttered safehouse window wearing a sleek matte-black high-collar belted trench coat with brushed metal cufflinks and a strapped thigh holster. Using two fingers to pry open a narrow slit in the metal venetian blinds, she checks the rainy street below while signaling silence back toward the viewer with her free hand. Razor-sharp bars of cyan and red neon rainlight slice across her black hair and coat, contrasting with the faint emerald standby glow of the desk monitor.
data.story: 楼下雨街闪过两道可疑车灯。夏目迅速熄灭台灯，半蹲在百叶窗边用两指轻轻拨开一条窄缝窥视街角，反手稳稳按住你的手腕示意噤声，终端机微弱的绿光映亮她冷静得近乎锋利的金瞳——「巡逻车刚拐过去。别动，等三分钟再转移。」
